preview_mean_latency_ms.Description: Mean across the participant's preview trials of detection latency. Detection latency: onset of the last fixation of the trial (the one that landed on the face) relative to search-display onset. Fixations beginning within 100 ms of onset are discarded, timeout trials are dropped, and in the face detection task the stimuli in config.EXCLUDE_STIMULI are excluded. Plotted on the raw scale; the paired test is computed on log latency.
